ingredients.name: sweet potato, peeled and cut into half-inch chunks
red pepper, cut into half-inch pieces

steps.instruction: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and stir for 2 minutes.
Add 2 tablespoons of curry paste and 1 tablespoon of minced ginger.
steps.spoken: Add 2 tablespoons of Thai red curry paste and 1 tablespoon of minced ginger. Cook for 1 minute, stirring.

steps.instruction: Add 1 sweet potato, 1 zucchini and 1 red pepper, all in half-inch pieces.
Add 1/2 cup of water and some salt, then stir.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
steps.spoken: Cover and cook for 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the vegetables are soft.

steps.instruction: Add 1 can of chickpeas, plus the finely grated zest and juice of 1 lime.
Stir often for 5 minutes, until the liquid has cooked away.
steps.spoken: Stir often for 5 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the liquid has cooked away.

steps.instruction: Whisk 3 tablespoons of wheat flour into 1 1/2 cups of milk.
Stir the flour and milk into the pan slowly and bring to a simmer.
steps.spoken: Stir the flour and milk into the pan a little at a time, stirring all the time, and bring to a simmer.

steps.instruction: Lower to medium heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in 1/2 cup of chopped coriander, and more salt if needed.
